name: Weather
reason: Folks, this is a pretty decent setup for algae with a warm 27.0C average high and just 4.6 mm of rain keeping the water fairly calm, but only 2 truly hot days and mid-September's fading sun keep me from calling it a slam dunk.
evidence: Average max temp of 27.0C is warm enough to support cyanobacteria growth
Only 4.6 mm of rain total, too little to flush or mix the lake
Just 2 hot days, so no sustained heat wave to push a bloom strongly
Mid September timing means declining sunlight and heat compared with peak summer
